text.p: National TechTeam Inc, which reported lower earnings for the second quarter and first half of the year, said the second half of the year will be aided by new contracts and acquisitions.

"TechTeam expects to have a good second half of the year fueled by a number of major new contracts and acquisitions," William Coyro Jr, chairman, said in a statement. "Demand for National TechTeam's services continues to be strong and the company is well positioned to execute on this new business through the investments in technology and facilities made during the first half of 1997."

Earlier, National TechTeam reported a drop in second quarter earnings to $0.01 a share from $0.09, which the company said were in line with its July 21 announcement that results would be below analysts' expectations.
For the first six months, National TechTeam earned $0.12 a share, down from $0.17 a year ago.

National TechTeam, which provides information technology outsourcing support services, reported higher revenues of $18.5 million in the second quarter, compared with $15.8 million a year ago. Growth in revenues reflected increasing demand for computer services.
